summary: Exactly ONE first-party marketing tag is CONFIGURED on this page: a Google Tag Manager container. Read the servedInHtml / injectedAtHydration split below before treating it as observed — in the served HTML only the body <noscript> iframe is present; the head <script> bootstrap lives in the __NUXT_DATA__ payload and is injected at hydration. There is NO hardcoded GA4 tag, NO Google Ads conversion tag, NO Facebook/Meta pixel and NO CallRail script anywhere in the page HTML or in the payload. Any GA4 / Ads / pixel firing must be happening from inside the GTM container, which is not inspectable from the static HTML.
captureCaveat: This capture is a GHL PREVIEW render, not the public production response. Evidence: every runtime JS chunk is served from stcdn.leadconnectorhq.com/_preview/... (36 occurrences of the token /_preview/: 35 full stcdn.leadconnectorhq.com URLs plus the Nuxt buildAssetsDir:"/_preview/" config value) and the form wrapper carries is-preview="true". form.json already flags this for form behaviour; it applies equally here. Treat head-injected tags as CONFIGURED, not as OBSERVED — a production render could differ in what is server-side vs client-side injected. Everything recorded under notFound was verified absent from BOTH the rendered DOM and the resolved Nuxt payload, so those absences are robust to the preview/production difference.

ONLY the body <noscript> iframe is server-rendered. The head <script> is NOT in the served HTML — it is carried as an escaped string inside the __NUXT_DATA__ payload and injected client-side at hydration.

For the CallRail DNI work: there is currently no call-tracking script of any kind on the page, and the nine tel: anchors are hardcoded. Three distinct numbers are in play and one anchor's label does not match its href — see structure.md > PHONE TREATMENT before installing any swap.
